# dokploy_networks (Data Source)

Fetches Dokploy networks, optionally filtered by server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_id` (String) Optional remote server ID filter.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) List of Dokploy networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `attachable` (Boolean) Whether standalone containers can attach to the network.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `driver` (String) Docker network driver.
- `enable_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether IPv4 is enabled.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 is enabled.
- `id` (String) Network ID.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the network is internal.
- `ipam` (Attributes) IPAM settings for the network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks--ipam))
- `mtu` (Number) Network MTU if configured.
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID that owns this network.
- `server_id` (String) Associated Dokploy server ID, when remote.

<a id="nestedatt--networks--ipam"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks.ipam`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Attributes List) IPAM config entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks--ipam--config))
- `driver` (String) IPAM driver.

<a id="nestedatt--networks--ipam--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks.ipam.config`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP.
- `ip_range` (String) IP range.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet CIDR.
